verification_method: Read DATA_FILES.json and DATA_SUMMARY.json without modifying either file.
Enumerate actual files beneath the dataset root and compare every manifest payload path and byte size against its physical file.
Aggregate physical payload file counts and byte sizes by dataset and compare them against DATA_SUMMARY.json.
Count images only beneath images/ directories with jpg, jpeg, png, webp or bmp extensions.
This final inventory check did not recompute all content hashes; the build-stage source/destination SHA-256 verification is separately recorded in DATA_FILES.json and DATA_SUMMARY.json.

additional_regenerable_files_observed.note: These files were already present when the read-only verification started and were not created by this verification. They are regenerable runtime caches, not required payload files. Their final inclusion/removal is controlled by the primary packaging workflow.

verification_method: Parse the preserved QianDuan/app.py with Python ast.
Extract and compile the original sample_images, random_sample and select_batch_samples function definitions without importing or launching the frontend.
Read CLASS_INFO from the original source and provide the same constants, random module, CSV parser, threading lock and pathlib Path objects.
Point SAMPLE_DATA_ROOT and SAMPLE_IMAGES_ROOT at D:/Data/project/PiFuData/processed_skin7_v3 and its images directory, matching reproduction/front.py.
Call select_batch_samples(100) for 100 rounds and assert unique file paths, seven class counts of 14 or 15, and 50 samples from each split.
In each round call random_sample for test and val, checking that the chosen path exists and differs from the immediately previous choice.
frontend_sampling.limitation: This verifies original sampling behavior and portable path wiring. It is not a 100-image prediction test and does not certify model numerical outputs.
